It holds the pod-template and pod schemas, community/pod.rs (read/parse/fill/document/logged), memory per subject (NoteFields.subject/by, read_index/read_note take subject), first_turn Creator.subject/fresh, and show/spawn --subject/--fresh wiring. Next: build, fix, test, then amend the commit message. The CLI spawn still sends subject None and fresh false.
Lessons:
- assign_many can fail AFTER its git commit (index/flush). Use assign_landing, which tells AssignError::Refused (roll back) from Landed (keep the seat and warn with `pij directory rebuild`). Never roll back a spawn whose commit landed.
- To inject a store failure in an HTTP test, create a SQLite trigger on the rig's fresh DB (rig._fresh.path()): `CREATE TRIGGER ... BEFORE INSERT ON community_assignments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,...) END`.
- A mutant check for a pid guard: a unit test on a real `/bin/sleep` child with a wrong start time. The mutant kills the child, so the test fails.
- Session history is a READ: every registry write appends a spine `seat.put` with the whole descriptor (session, proc, model, spawn_id). The spine is never pruned and is indexed (seat, kind, seq). Read past context from a capped transcript tail (256 KiB), else unknown.
- The PM principle for pods: every check warns and still starts. Withholding pod work from a degraded slot is a BRAKE on pij's own dispatch.
- The skill_verb_coverage test reads `pij-rs <verb> --help`. Document flags of argv-forwarded verbs (close) in the clap doc comment.
- A new role-template version file must be biome-formatted BEFORE pinning its sha256 (CI check 22/24 runs biome).
- The `fyis` helper in directory_http filters PRD 007's creator notes. A new FYI type changes every test that counts a prime's FYIs.
- Disk: shared-build refuses under 25 GB. One build takes about 12 GB. Tell the PM; never lower the floor or delete target/.
